episode_title: Part 2 with Dave Baumgartner of Bluemont Group

real_qa.q: How many Dunkin' Donuts locations does Bluemont Group operate and what is their expansion plan?
real_qa.r: Bluemont Group currently operates 89 Dunkin' locations across multiple markets including East Tennessee, Knoxville, Chattanooga, Birmingham, and Kansas City. If they build everything they are obligated to build, they will have 211 stores total, with a timeline requiring them to build 15-20 stores per year over the next 8-10 years.
real_qa.requete: Bluemont Group Dunkin Donuts locations 211 stores

real_qa.q: What is the annual donut production capacity at Bluemont Group's Ringgold bakery facility?
real_qa.r: The bakery facility in Ringgold, Georgia is 60,000 square feet and produces 100,000 dozen donuts per week, which equals approximately one million donuts per week. They supply donuts to about 220 stores every night, including their own locations and other approved Dunkin' franchisees.
real_qa.requete: Bluemont Group bakery 1 million donuts weekly production

real_qa.q: What was the Valentine's Day donut delivery failure at Bluemont Group and how did it impact operations?
real_qa.r: On Valentine's Day, Bluemont Group had to deliver 98,000 chocolate-filled heart-shaped donuts compared to their normal nightly production of 12,000, but failed to account for the mix complexity. Although they had production capacity, filling 98,000 donuts by hand meant they did not begin deliveries until 2 a.m., missing their 11 p.m. start time, resulting in many retailers not having donuts when they opened and was described as the worst professional day.
real_qa.requete: Bluemont Group Valentine's Day 98000 donuts delivery failure

real_qa.q: What were Bluemont Group's first four Dunkin' locations and how did they adapt existing buildings?
real_qa.r: Dave Baumgartner's first four Dunkin' locations were in Hickson and Fort Oglethorpe, Georgia; East Brainerd in Chattanooga; and Athens, Tennessee. The East Brainerd location was converted from a car wash, retaining its tunnel structure with a drive-thru window, and the building was 3,000 square feet with over half being unused space.
real_qa.requete: Bluemont Group first Dunkin locations East Brainerd car wash

real_qa.q: How much does it cost to build a new Dunkin' Donuts location according to Bluemont Group's experience?
real_qa.r: Building costs for Dunkin' locations have increased significantly. End cap locations formerly cost $500,000-$600,000 and are now $800,000-$900,000, while freestanding locations used to cost around $1 million and some new construction is forecasted over $2 million.

guest.bio_context: Dave Baumgartner is a Dunkin' Donuts franchisee who has built a multi-state operation starting with four initial locations in 2008. He previously worked at Procter & Gamble in manufacturing and at Anderson (a major logistics company handling distribution). His business has grown to operate 89 Dunkin' locations across East Tennessee, Knoxville, Chattanooga, Birmingham, Kansas City, and other markets, with plans to reach 211 total locations.

real_quote: If you owe a million, you're probably worth ten. That was his comment.
